A1.evidence: Machine gate PASS (ground truth): 0 axe serious+critical, 0 contrast failures (axe and measured), focus indicator on 82/82 tabbed controls, 0 animations running under prefers-reduced-motion. Council docks 1 for the residual the gate logged but did not gate: a moderate 'region' violation on thread/light, thread/dark and thread-crisis/light, where the composer <textarea aria-label="message pip"> sits outside any landmark on the screen users live in. Chair-verified second residual in the pixels: meditation-pause-light offers no visible pause control at all (only an X at top-right and a '4-4-4-4 Box · switch rhythm' pill), so the breathing animation cannot be stopped by anyone who is not tabbing with a screen reader. User & Brand Advocate's 12/12 voided (rests on the gate passing).

A2.evidence: Machine gate PASS: 0/217 block-level interactive targets under 44x44, 0 inline links under 44px, primary action present, >=44px and in the thumb zone on 21/21 screens (onboarding CTAs 342x56, composer 44x44). Council docks 1 for placement, which the gate does not measure: chair-verified on timeline-light that the app's only two navigation controls are 20px icons at the top right of the bar (chat glyph approx x=304, gear approx x=352, y=28) where the design spec asks for a two-item bottom nav. Also chair-verified: the mood-filter row is sliced mid-chip at x=390 ('ca...') with no scroll cue, and memory-card has no primary action at all (gate: 'zone n/a'), its only forward affordance being the 14px tab row at y=98. User & Brand Advocate's 8/8 voided (gate restatement); median unchanged.

A3.evidence: Machine gate PASS: 95.2% of spacing on the 8pt grid, the only off-8 value is 4px x98, 0 values off even the 4pt half-grid, 0 misaligned sibling blocks across 21 screens. Chair-verified counter-evidence in the pixels: on settings-light the 'get help now' card and the 'account' row sit 22px apart at the same width with the same padding and two visibly different corner radii (approx 20px vs approx 16px), and the timeline stack runs three different card insets in one column. Timeline is the weakest screen at 84.8% on-grid, with the block rhythm alternating approx 24 / 16 / 24px for a single vertical stack. Ergonomics Auditor's 6/8 voided (self-declared 'scoring on the gate's own numbers rather than an independent audit') and User & Brand Advocate's 8/8 voided (pure gate restatement).

A4.evidence: Machine gate PASS: 6 type sizes (12/14/16/18/24/32px), 3 families (fraunces, fredoka, nunito), 3 weights (400/600/700), 70/20/10 proxy on 21/21 screens. The three-role split is honoured where it counts, chair-verified: thread-light bubbles are Nunito and the memory-card-light reflection is Fraunces. Council docks 1 on pixel evidence: chair-verified on meditation-pause-light that 'breathe in...' renders in Fraunces and is the largest type on the screen, while the brand reserves the reading serif for memory surfaces so the shift means something; and timeline-light runs surface 48.8% against cream 41.5%, two neutrals at parity, so the payoff page has no single ground. Three advisors also assert the source carries text-[15px]/[11px]/[17px] beyond the gate's six, but that is a stale-worktree claim the chair could not verify and the gate wins. Interaction Engineer's and Ergonomics Auditor's 6/6 both voided (gate restatement plus unverifiable code).

A5.evidence: Machine gate PASS: 0 console errors, 0 warnings, 0 failed requests; CLS <= 0.013 on 21/21 (cap 0.1); FCP 36-92ms on 21/21; 0 dead-end screens; 0 horizontal overflow. Council cross-check the machine did not catch, chair-verified on all three thread renders (thread-light, thread-dark, thread-crisis-light): the frame opens on a clipped user bubble at y=0 with no top bar in view, so the app's home screen shows no Pip avatar, no 'pip' wordmark and no route to timeline or settings. This does not overturn '0 dead ends' (the composer is present and functional) and the gate wins, but it must be checked live in round 02. Chair-verified the other way too: the 'ca...' chip clipped at x=390 on timeline-light is an internal scroller, not page overflow, consistent with the gate's 0. Three scores voided (Interaction Engineer 6/6, Ergonomics Auditor 6/6, User & Brand Advocate 6/6) leaving a two-score median of 5.5.

B1.evidence: Chair-verified on timeline-light at a 390x844 viewport: above the fold sit an h1 ('your story', 32px Fredoka), a subtitle, a 'last 7 days' pill, an entire 'this week's flow' card (header + '7 reflections' count + seven dots + a weekday axis + a numeric axis), a search field and a six-item chip row, and only then at y=452 the words 'TODAY'S KEEPSAKE', with the date at y=495 -- 59% down the phone. Five entry points before one word of the user's own day. Best in class the other way, chair-verified: onboarding-welcome and onboarding-notify are one Pip, one line, one honey CTA with nothing competing. settings-subscription-light's focal point is the word 'free' at 24px, sitting above roughly 548px of empty cream.

B2.evidence: Genuine systemization, chair-verified: the crisis resource list is one component rendered both inline in thread-crisis-light and as the whole of help-light (identical five region rows -- US, CANADA, UK & IRELAND, AUSTRALIA, ANYWHERE), and the segmented pill inverts correctly between memory-card-light and memory-card-dark. Against it, chair-verified across five screens: the back link is five different conventions -- 'back to pip' (settings), 'settings' (subscription), 'your story' (locked paywall), 'back' (help) and 'keepsake edition' (memory detail, which names the page you are already on). Same day, two labels: 'Mixed' on timeline vs 'A mixed day' on the memory card. Same $4.99 purchase, two voices one tap apart: 'keep it all · $4.99/mo' vs 'upgrade to Pip+ ($4.99/mo)'. And onboarding-welcome floats its CTA at y=566 while the other four onboarding steps anchor at y=816. Interaction Engineer's 7/7 voided: it rests on stale-worktree claims ('--radius-card/--radius-bubble/--radius-pill are the only radii used') that the pixels refute.

B3.evidence: Four of five advisors converge on 5-6, and their convergent deduction -- the 380ms bubble-in against the rubric's 150-300ms band -- is a stale-worktree code citation the chair could not verify, so this is the softest median in the report and is labelled as such. What is pixel-verifiable is thin: on timeline-light the full memory card's forward affordance is a small 'open ->' in the card's bottom-right rather than the whole card, while the compact cards below it are wholly tappable -- two hit-area contracts for the same 'open this day' intent on one screen. Credit where the reviews agree and the shapes are visible in the renders: shape-matched skeleton bars under 'pip is wrapping up monday...' rather than a spinner, an optimistic pending bubble at reduced opacity, and a "didn't send · tap to retry" affordance rather than a stuck state.

B4.evidence: Gate-verified: 0 running animations under prefers-reduced-motion on 8/8 sampled screens -- honoured completely, not merely shortened. Chair-verified on meditation-pause-light: the breath ring carries a real progress marker at the top of the circle and Pip sits inside it eyes-closed and blushing, so the motion has a job; no parallax, no scroll reveals, no animated gradient anywhere in the 26 renders. Against it, four independent reviews agree that reduced motion stops Pip's breathe/blink entirely rather than easing it down, against the design spec's explicit 'Pip still lives', and that the bubble-in spring cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1) overshoots on every message arrival where the brand asks for 'fade + rise'. Both are code-only claims; the direction is conservative and consistent, so the deduction stands but its precision does not.

B5.evidence: Could only be Pip, chair-verified: the mascot is hand-authored (sprout, blush cheeks, expression carried in the eyes alone) and it acts -- open-eyed and listening on onboarding-welcome, closed and cozy on meditation-pause, smiling on the paywall. 'the days you gave pip, kept.' and 'kept by pip' are lines no template writes. Against it, chair-verified on timeline-light-full: 'Later,' is the connective in 7 of 7 reflections, producing non-sentences ('Later, but i made it through, and i'm home now', 'Later, but i got through it, and that count...'), and every compact card's title is the first four words of its own body -- 'Went for a walk' over 'Went for a walk under the amber leaves after lunch.', 'Hard day honestly, everything' over 'Hard day honestly, everything felt heavy.' One reflection ends 'i'll take it....' -- an ellipsis plus a period. Interaction Engineer's and Ergonomics Auditor's 7/8 both voided: both rest on 'no generic SaaS copy in any of the 26 screens', refuted by 'upgrade to Pip+ ($4.99/mo)' and 'refresh status' on settings-subscription-light.

C1.evidence: Onboarding is exemplary and chair-verified: one question per screen, a progress bar at the top, and a visible escape on every optional step. settings-light is five rows and a sign-out with 'get help now -- real people, any time -- if things feel heavy' pinned above them where a tired person finds it first. Against it, chair-verified on timeline-light: the screen asks a person to parse four navigation systems -- a seven-dot week strip, a '7 reflections' counter, a search field and a mood-filter chip row -- before it returns a single day they wrote. Chair-verified detail: two of the seven week-strip dots carry a half-filled-circle glyph that reads as a display-settings icon, the only piece of UI chrome in a set otherwise made of sun, cloud, heart and waves.

C2.evidence: The voice lands where it matters, chair-verified: onboarding-welcome pairs 'hey, i'm pip / a place to put your thoughts down. no rules, just talk to me whenever.' with 'i'm a companion, not a therapist. if things ever get heavy, help is one tap away.' The crisis reply on thread-crisis-light is the best writing in the build: 'i'm a small app, not a person who can keep you safe right now -- but there are people who can, and they're there for exactly this. i'll stay here while you reach them.' Against it, chair-verified on thread-light: scroll back and Pip is silent for two days -- Sat Sep 5 carries two user bubbles and no reply, Sun Sep 6 two more and no reply -- and Pip's live reply to 'but i made it through, and i'm home now' is 'you made it through.', a four-word echo. On thread-dark, chair-verified: Pip's bubbles are neutral grey while the user's blaze honey at 26.2% of the screen, so Pip is the warm one in light and the cold one in dark, and glary at 1am. Interaction Engineer's 7/7 voided: it rests on 'Pip's avatar is present in the thread header', refuted -- no header appears in any of the three thread renders.

C3.evidence: The reveal is composed with care and chair-verified: a 'TODAY'S KEEPSAKE' eyebrow, the date in Fraunces, mood as colour plus one soft glyph, '2 moments kept' and a tiny Pip signature reading 'kept by pip' -- no confetti, no streak counter, no second currency. But the moment the whole product builds to, chair-verified on memory-card-light and memory-card-dark: a date that orphan-wraps to '6, 2026' on a second line, a paragraph reading 'Later, turns out the team was cheering for me', no photos at all (the design spec asks the card to carry the day's), no share affordance, and content ending at y=528 with approximately 316px of bare cream below it -- 37% of an 844px viewport. Nothing distinguishes a good day from a hard one: Sep 2's 'small win but i'll take it' gets the identical card shape as Sep 1's 'hard day honestly'. Interaction Engineer's 6/6 voided (rests entirely on stale-worktree code for a delight claim, with no screenshot corroboration).

C4.evidence: Capture is genuinely two taps -- the thread is the landing screen and the composer is pinned with the field already there -- and onboarding is five short, skippable steps comfortably under 60s. The paywall is the strongest commercial writing in the build, chair-verified on both timeline-light-full and memory-locked-paywall-light: cozy Pip, 'keep your whole story', the price flat inside the button as 'keep it all · $4.99/mo', 'not right now' as a real exit at equal weight, and 'cancel anytime · export and delete stay free, always' -- no dark pattern in either theme. Friction, chair-verified: at rest the honey circle in the composer is a microphone, not send, so the highest-affordance control under the thumb does not do what a chat composer trains you to expect; and memory-locked-paywall-light shows nothing of the day it is withholding -- a back link at y=45, then approximately 415px of flat undimmed cream, then the sheet. The moment of loss has no face.

redFlags: timeline-light-full + memory-card-light: reflection body and compact-card titles — mail-merge templating. Chair-verified: 'Later,' is the connective in 7 of 7 reflections, producing non-sentences ('Later, but i made it through, and i'm home now'); every compact card's title is the first four words of its own body, so each card says the same phrase twice and one is titled 'Hard day honestly, everything', stopping mid-clause; capitalisation collides inside one paragraph; one reflection ends 'i'll take it....' Round 00's council flagged the same defect with a different template — round 01 changed the template and kept the templating, on the one surface that must feel precious.

settings-subscription-light: CTA and secondary button — off-voice generic copy. Chair-verified: 'upgrade to Pip+ ($4.99/mo)' and 'refresh status' — a title-cased product name, a parenthesised price and engineering vocabulary in an app that is lowercase everywhere else, 40px away in the IA from a paywall that says 'keep it all · $4.99/mo'. Bundled: meditation-pause-light labels its control '4-4-4-4 Box · switch rhythm', naming its own algorithm on the calmest screen; round 00 flagged that exact string and it is unchanged.

settings-subscription-light + memory-card-light/dark + memory-locked-paywall-light/dark: page bottoms and tops — floaty balance. Chair-measured on an 844px viewport: the subscription screen holds a 96px card at the top and approximately 548px of empty cream before its buttons; the memory card ends at y=528 with approximately 316px of nothing under it; the locked paywall shows a back link at y=45, then approximately 415px of flat undimmed cream, then the sheet. Round 00 flagged the same three screens at 540 / 300 / 440px — unmoved.

timeline-light-full: the card column — one texture, identical shapes stacked down the page. Chair-verified: roughly ten same-width (358px) white rounded rectangles run down a single column on cream — week-flow card, search pill, two full cards, five identical compact cards, paywall — with no change of ground or rhythm. The Systems Designer refuted this on the grounds that the timeline deliberately tiers full vs compact cards, and that tiering is real, but two shapes do not answer the flag when five of the eight cards are identical and machine-filled. Round 00 raised this flag and it is substantially unchanged.
topFixes: Rewrite the keepsake so it isn't visibly stitched. Screen: timeline-light-full and memory-card-light; elements: the reflection body and the compact-card title. Targets: zero occurrences of the 'Later,' bridge across all seven days (currently 7/7); no card title derived from the first N words of its own body, so 'Hard day honestly, everything' and 'Went for a walk' stop repeating the sentence beneath them; one capitalisation convention inside a reflection; no two of the seven days sharing a closing shape. Hand-write seven distinct first-person reflections if the fixture must stay deterministic. Clears red flag 1, removes the main driver of red flag 4, and is the largest simultaneous lift available to B5, C2 and C3 — roughly 5-6 points for a copy-layer change with no layout risk.

Give the three payoff screens a bottom, and the paywall a face. Screens: memory-card-light/dark, settings-subscription-light, memory-locked-paywall-light/dark. Targets: on the memory card, fill the approximately 316px below y=528 with the day's photos (the design spec asks the card to carry them; none appears in any of the 26 renders) and anchor a previous/next-day control in the thumb zone, and set the date on one line so '6, 2026' stops orphaning; on the subscription screen, move the CTA directly under the plan card to close the approximately 548px void, delete 'refresh status', and reuse the paywall's own words in place of 'upgrade to Pip+ ($4.99/mo)'; on the locked paywall, render the withheld day behind the sheet — date legible, reflection softly veiled — instead of approximately 415px of blank cream. Clears red flags 2 and 3 and lifts B1, C3 and C4.

Raise the keepsake above the fold and give the thread its head back. Screen: timeline-light; elements: the 'this week's flow' card, the search field and the filter chip row. Target: the first keepsake's date above y=300 instead of y=495 — set the seven dots directly under the 'your story' h1 as its second line, move search behind the magnifier in the top bar, move the mood filters into that search sheet, and fix the chip row clipped at x=390 so a thumb can tell there is more. In the same pass, confirm live whether the thread's top bar renders: it is absent from all three thread frames, leaving the app's home screen with no identity and no route to timeline or settings. Lifts B1 and C1 and closes the one defect the machine gate cannot see.

jury.why: Mixed-family jury (2 Opus, 1 Fable, 2 Sonnet) rather than round 01's original single-family Haiku panel; the chair independently opened 14 of the 26 screenshots and personally verified every load-bearing and disputed claim, and the three pixel-anchored reviews converge tightly at 74/75/80 around the 77 median — but confidence is qualified: no anonymized peer round ran, and two advisors' worktrees held an earlier revision than the build that was screenshotted, so 14 code-only scores were voided and the B3/B4 medians rest on evidence stills cannot carry.

summary: Round 01 is a successful gate-repair round — all five Tier A gates now pass and no hard cap is live, worth +14.5 of the +19 improvement over round 00's 58 — but the craft criteria barely moved, because the keepsake at the product's centre is still visibly mail-merged ('Later,' joins 7 of 7 reflections, every compact card titles itself with the first four words of its own body), three screens end in 300-550px of empty cream, the payoff sits 59% down the timeline behind a week strip and a filter row, and dark mode leaves Pip the cold one — a 77, not the 96.5 the original single-family Haiku jury returned.
